name: Saifeleslam Elsayed
title: Full Stack Engineer
summary: I build secure web platforms, distributed backend systems, real-time workflows, and polished user experiences.

about.past: My path into software engineering started at Cairo University and widened through a scholarship experience at San José State University. Internships, volunteer work, and a lot of hands-on building gave me a practical foundation in web engineering—and taught me to value curiosity, ownership, and clear thinking.
about.present: Today, I work across the stack on production systems at AvidBeam and Thaat. My work spans React and Ruby on Rails applications, distributed services, real-time and asynchronous workflows, multi-tenant data systems, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations. I also build and deploy freelance products, collaborating closely with designers and engineers to turn complete user journeys into reliable software.
about.hobbies: Away from the keyboard, I spend time at the gym and follow documentaries and current affairs, especially economics and history. Both are good reminders that every system—technical or otherwise—has people and tradeoffs behind it.
